name: Train Vega
about: Make a separate, trained Vega model that learns from Gemma's and Qwen's answers. Your Vega app stays exactly as it is, and you switch to the new model only if it turns out better.
decided: She learns her personality, Tenglish replies, simple coding help, and facts about you
Teachers: Gemma (`gemma3:4b`) answers the chats, Qwen (`qwen2.5-coder:3b`) answers the code
Training runs free on Google Colab, because your laptop's 4 GB graphics card is too small
The result is a new model called `vega-trained`. The current Vega and its models don't change
Only use facts you're OK uploading to Google. Never passwords, Aadhaar or PAN, bank details or OTPs
Shutdown, WhatsApp calls and other laptop actions stay in Vega's code, not in the trained model

steps.title: Plan Vega's personality
steps: Make the folder `C:\CloudLab\vega-train`
In Notepad, write `vega_card.txt`: who Vega is, how she talks, and 10 rules
List facts about you that are safe to upload: studies, goals, routine

steps.title: Write practice questions
steps: 25 questions about Vega herself
25 everyday chats in Tenglish
25 simple coding questions (Python, C, Linux)
25 questions about you, from your safe facts list
Save them all in `questions.txt`

steps.title: Let the teachers answer
steps: Ask Claude for the teacher script when you reach this lesson
Run it: Gemma answers the chats, Qwen answers the code
It saves every question and answer in one file

steps.title: Check and fix the answers
steps: Read the answers and fix the Tenglish yourself
Delete wrong or strange answers
Keep at least 200 good ones

steps.title: Set up Google Colab
steps: Sign in to colab.research.google.com with your personal Gmail
Open Unsloth's free fine-tuning notebook (ask Claude for the current link)
Runtime → Change runtime type → T4 GPU

steps.title: Train Vega
steps: Upload your answers file to Colab
Run the training cells (about 30 to 60 minutes)
Save the result as a GGUF file (`q4_k_m`) and download it

steps.title: Run her in Ollama
steps: Put the GGUF file in `C:\CloudLab\vega-train` and rename it `vega-trained.gguf`
Make a file called `Modelfile` with the line `FROM ./vega-trained.gguf`
`ollama create vega-trained -f Modelfile`, then `ollama run vega-trained`

steps.title: Compare and decide
steps: Ask the old Vega and vega-trained the same 20 questions
Keep the one that answers better
Write in your notes what you learned
